voice.instructions: Classify the user voice utterance while using a live coding assistant.

criteria.stop: The user is ONLY telling the currently speaking voice to stop talking, shut up, or pause, with no new task or question.
criteria.noise: Meaningless filler, cough, breath, or non-communicative noise (e.g. euh, hmm, uh) not directed at the assistant.
criteria.pass: Any greeting, question, request, instruction, feedback, or meaningful speech directed at the assistant in any language.

fromContext.instructions: Is the user asking to present, summarize, zoom in on, explain, or discuss results or topics already found or displayed on screen, rather than asking to write code or launch a brand new external action?

worthSpeaking.instructions: Is this tool-activity summary important or unexpected enough to inform the user aloud, rather than routine reading or listing?
